title: How To Do Chest Flies On The Machine
hook: Chest flies are far superior to bench press for building your chest. Here's how to do them on the machine.
body:
First, set the seat in the right position. This is really important. Set it so that the handles line up with the middle of your chest.

Second, set the starting position so you feel a stretch in your chest. But don't set it so far back that you risk tearing a pec. That way you still get the stretch and it stays low risk. As far back as you can go, but no farther.

Next, keep a slight bend in your elbows. Bring the handles together in front of your chest and squeeze. Then let them back slowly to the stretch.

For your sets, do one easy warm-up set of 10 to 15 reps. Then do two working sets of 8 to 12 reps. Every working rep should be strict. Take two to three seconds on the way down, then explode up.
